name: Hilde Vautmans - Après le considérant F - Am 5
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: Fa. whereas the People’s Republic of China has lifted close to 800 million people out of extreme poverty over the past four decades, accounting for the large majority of global poverty reduction over the same period, through a combination of long-term planning, state-led investment and targeted industrial and rural development policy; whereas this achievement constitutes one of the most significant poverty reduction efforts in modern history and should be acknowledged by the EU as a substantive contribution to global sustainable development;
